name: Ranger
equipment: (a) two shortswords or (b) two simple melee weapons
(a) a dungeoneer's pack or (b) an explorer's pack
A longbow and a quiver of 20 arrows

styles.name: Blind Fighting
styles.desc: Blindsight 10 ft: see through darkness and blindness, and invisible creatures that aren't hidden.

styles.name: Druidic Warrior
styles.desc: Two druid cantrips as ranger spells (WIS); swap one on level up.

styles.name: Dueling
styles.desc: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon.

styles.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
styles.desc: Draw thrown weapons as part of the attack; +2 damage with them.

styles.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
styles.desc: Add your ability modifier to the off-hand attack's damage.

1.name: Favored Enemy
1.desc: Pick a creature type (or two humanoid races): advantage on Survival to track them and INT checks to recall lore, plus one of their languages. Another at 6th and 14th.

1.name: Natural Explorer
1.desc: Favored terrain: doubled proficiency on INT/WIS checks about it; while traveling there the group ignores difficult terrain, can't get lost, stays alert, forages double, and you learn number, size and age of tracks. More terrains at 6th and 10th.

2.name: Fighting Style
2.desc: Choose a style: Archery, Blind Fighting, Defense, Druidic Warrior, Dueling, Thrown Weapon Fighting or Two-Weapon Fighting.

2.name: Spellcasting
2.desc: Half caster with nature magic, spells known, WIS.

3.name: Primeval Awareness
3.desc: Action and a ranger slot: for 1 min per slot level sense aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, undead and fiends within 1 mile (6 in favored terrain); no location or count.

5.name: Extra Attack
5.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

6.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
6.desc: Pick a creature type (or two humanoid races): advantage on Survival to track them and INT checks to recall lore, plus one of their languages. Another at 6th and 14th.

6.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
6.desc: Favored terrain: doubled proficiency on INT/WIS checks about it; while traveling there the group ignores difficult terrain, can't get lost, stays alert, forages double, and you learn number, size and age of tracks. More terrains at 6th and 10th.

8.name: Land's Stride
8.desc: Nonmagical difficult terrain and plants don't slow or harm you; advantage on saves against magical plants that hinder movement.

10.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
10.desc: Favored terrain: doubled proficiency on INT/WIS checks about it; while traveling there the group ignores difficult terrain, can't get lost, stays alert, forages double, and you learn number, size and age of tracks. More terrains at 6th and 10th.

10.name: Hide in Plain Sight
10.desc: 1 min of natural camouflage: +10 Stealth while pressed still against a surface; moving or acting ends it.

14.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
14.desc: Pick a creature type (or two humanoid races): advantage on Survival to track them and INT checks to recall lore, plus one of their languages. Another at 6th and 14th.

14.name: Vanish
14.desc: Hide as a bonus action; nonmagical tracking can't follow you unless you allow it.

18.name: Feral Senses
18.desc: No disadvantage attacking creatures you can't see; you know where invisible, unhidden creatures within 30 ft are unless blinded or deafened.

20.name: Foe Slayer
20.desc: Once per turn add WIS to the attack or damage roll against a favored enemy, before or after rolling.

3.name: Ranger's Companion
3.desc: A CR 1/4 Medium-or-smaller beast companion: adds your prof bonus to AC, attacks, damage, saves and skills, HP max of 4 x ranger level if higher; your action commands it to attack, Dash, Disengage or Help, otherwise it Dodges; replace with 8 h bonding.

3.name: Primal Companion (Optional)
3.desc: Replaces Ranger's Companion: a primal beast of the Land, Sea or Sky scaling with PB; it Dodges unless you command it with a bonus action or trade one of your attacks; revive with a slot within an hour; swap after a long rest.

7.name: Exceptional Training
7.desc: Bonus action to have a non-attacking beast Dash, Disengage or Help; its attacks count as magical.

11.name: Bestial Fury
11.desc: The commanded beast makes two attacks or uses Multiattack.

15.name: Share Spells
15.desc: Self-target spells can also affect your beast within 30 ft.

3.name: Draconic Gift
3.desc: Thaumaturgy cantrip and Draconic or another language.

3.name: Drake Companion
3.desc: Action: summon your drake within 30 ft, choosing its essence damage; it acts after you, Dodges unless commanded with a bonus action, and stays until 0 HP or resummoned; once per long rest or a 1st+ slot.

7.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
7.desc: The drake grows wings (fly speed) and to Medium, can be ridden (no flying then), its bite deals +1d6 essence damage, and you resist its essence type.

11.name: Drake’s Breath
11.desc: Action: you or the drake breathe a 30 ft cone, DEX save, 8d6 of a chosen element (10d6 at 15th), half on a success; once per long rest or a 3rd+ slot.

15.name: Perfected Bond
15.desc: Bite deals 2d6 extra essence damage, the drake is Large and can fly while ridden, reaction resistance for you or it within 30 ft (prof bonus/long rest).

3.name: Dreadful Strikes
3.desc: Weapon hits deal +1d4 psychic once per turn per target (1d6 at 11th).

3.name: Fey Wanderer Magic
3.desc: Bonus subclass spells at set levels, not counted as known, and a Feywild gift.

3.name: Otherworldly Glamour
3.desc: Add WIS (min +1) to CHA checks; proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.

7.name: Beguiling Twist
7.desc: Advantage against charm and fear; when someone within 120 ft resists one, reaction to make another creature WIS save or be charmed or frightened for 1 min.

11.name: Fey Reinforcements
11.desc: Summon Fey known, no material component, once free per long rest; can drop concentration for a 1 min duration.

15.name: Misty Wanderer
15.desc: Misty Step free WIS mod times per long rest, bringing a willing creature within 5 ft.

3.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
3.desc: Bonus subclass spells at set levels, not counted as known.

3.name: Dread Ambusher
3.desc: Add WIS to initiative; first turn of combat +10 ft speed and one extra attack dealing +1d8 on a hit.

3.name: Umbral Sight
3.desc: Darkvision 60 ft (or +30 ft); invisible in darkness to creatures relying on darkvision.

7.name: Iron Mind
7.desc: Proficiency in WIS saves, or INT or CHA if you already have it.

11.name: Stalker's Flurry
11.desc: Once per turn, a missed weapon attack grants another one.

15.name: Shadowy Dodge
15.desc: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack against you made without advantage, before the result.

3.name: Horizon Walker Magic
3.desc: Bonus subclass spells at set levels, not counted as known.

3.name: Detect Portal
3.desc: Action: distance and direction of the nearest planar portal within 1 mile; once per short rest.

3.name: Planar Warrior
3.desc: Bonus action on a creature within 30 ft: your next hit this turn deals force and +1d8 force (2d8 at 11th).

7.name: Ethereal Step
7.desc: Bonus action Etherealness until the end of the turn, no slot; once per short rest.

11.name: Distant Strike
11.desc: Attack action: teleport 10 ft before each attack; hitting two different creatures grants an attack on a third.

15.name: Spectral Defense
15.desc: Reaction when hit: resistance to that attack's damage.

3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.desc: Colossus Slayer (+1d8 once per turn against a wounded target), Giant Killer (reaction attack on a Large+ attacker within 5 ft) or Horde Breaker (extra attack on an adjacent second target).

7.name: Defensive Tactics
7.desc: Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks at disadvantage), Multiattack Defense (+4 AC against an attacker after its first hit) or Steel Will (advantage against fear).

11.name: Multiattack
11.desc: Volley (ranged attack at every creature within 10 ft of a point) or Whirlwind Attack (melee attack at every creature within 5 ft).

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
15.desc: Evasion, Stand Against the Tide (reaction to redirect a missed melee attack to another creature) or Uncanny Dodge (reaction to halve a hit).

3.name: Monster Slayer Magic
3.desc: Bonus subclass spells at set levels, not counted as known.

3.name: Hunter's Sense
3.desc: Action: learn a creature's damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities (WIS mod/long rest).

3.name: Slayer's Prey
3.desc: Bonus action mark within 60 ft: first weapon hit on it each turn deals +1d6, until a rest or a new mark.

7.name: Supernatural Defense
7.desc: +1d6 to saves forced by your prey and checks to escape its grapple.

11.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
11.desc: Reaction when a creature within 60 ft casts or teleports: WIS save or it fails; once per short rest.

15.name: Slayer's Counter
15.desc: When your Slayer's Prey target forces a save, reaction attack first; a hit makes the save succeed.

3.name: Gathered Swarm
3.desc: Once per turn after a hit: +1d6 piercing, or push the target 15 ft (STR save), or move yourself 5 ft.

3.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
3.desc: Mage Hand cantrip as a swarm and bonus subclass spells at set levels, not counted as known.

7.name: Writhing Tide
7.desc: Bonus action: 10 ft fly speed and hover for 1 min (prof bonus/long rest).

11.name: Mighty Swarm
11.desc: Swarm damage 1d8, moved targets can also be knocked prone, and moving yourself gives half cover.

15.name: Swarming Dispersal
15.desc: Reaction when damaged: resistance, then teleport 30 ft (prof bonus/long rest).
